title: What Does Anti-Hallucination Training Buy? Saying Less, Cheap Pruning, and the Rest
abstract: arXiv:2611.25814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preference training is the standard recipe for reducing object hallucination in vision-language models, and each new method reports a lower CHAIR score. We ask what that reduction consists of. Every trained system is compared with its base model's caption truncated to the same object recall, which removes the part of the gain that comes from saying less; the remainder is compared with what a deliberately weak, frozen, eleven-feature post-hoc probe fitted on 500 annotated images can reproduce. All criteria were specified in the analysis code and frozen before the outputs they judge existed. For eight public methods on LLaVA-1.5-7B, the probe reproduces at least two thirds of what training removes beyond saying less for 7 of 8 methods on COCO, 8 of 8 on AMBER and 6 of 8 on Object HalBench, with RLAIF-V the consistent exception; a later public method released for both LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL (SENTINEL) meets the same bar on both. translated_title: 反幻觉训练究竟买到了什么？少说话、廉价剪枝，以及其余部分
translated_abstract: 偏好训练是减少视觉-语言模型中物体幻觉的标准方法，每种新方法都报告更低的CHAIR分数。我们追问这种降低究竟由什么构成。我们将每个训练后的系统与基础模型生成的字幕在相同物体召回率下截断后进行比较，从而剔除来自“少说话”的那部分收益；剩余部分则与一个刻意弱化的、冻结的、仅含十一个特征的后验探针（在500张标注图像上拟合）所能重现的效果进行比较。所有评判标准均在分析代码中预先指定，并在它们所要评判的输出产生之前就被冻结。对于LLaVA-1.5-7B上的八种公开方法，该探针在COCO上对7/8种方法、在AMBER上对8/8种方法、在Object HalBench上对6/8种方法，均能重现训练在“少说话”之外所消除的至少三分之二，其中RLAIF-V是一致的例外；随后发布的公开方法SENTINEL（同时适用于LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL）在两者上都达到了同样的标准。在我们的
tldr: 该论文证明，视觉-语言模型抗幻觉偏好训练所降低的幻觉，绝大部分可由“少说话”（截断字幕至相同召回率）以及一个仅用11个特征、在500张图上拟合的廉价后验探针剪枝所重现，说明训练带来的真实改进远小于表面数字。
en_tdlr: Most of the hallucination reduction achieved by anti-hallucination preference training in vision-language models can be reproduced by simply saying less (truncating captions at equal recall) and a deliberately weak eleven-feature post-hoc pruning probe fitted on 500 images, indicating that training itself contributes little genuine improvement beyond cheap filtering.
